body:
It's copied from the resource hints spec, and is consistent with how the anonymous keyword works for [links](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/#create-a-potential-cors-request). Since `anonymous` is the value for the  `crossorigin` attribute, I wouldn't expect it to affect same-origin connections.

However, I don't think chrome complies with this and this part in WebKit is [buggy](https://bugs.webkit.org/show_bug.cgi?id=239119). 

Also, same-origin preconnections seem a bit redundant to me, unless I'm missing a use-case.

@yoavweiss, thoughts?
